evidence: We use, develop, and incorporate within our technology platform and services, systems and tools that incorporate AI and machine learning, including generative AI.
Mr. Sliney leads our company's technology and operational areas with emphasis on cloud, data, and AI capabilities.

We seek to maintain an AI risk management framework that provides a centralized inventory of AI technologies, risk-based classification, security guardrails, and operational requirements prior to deployment.
Additionally, we may integrate AI into our operations, technology, products, and services in the future.
ai_positioning.summary: Stifel intègre activement l'IA et le machine learning dans ses opérations, sa plateforme technologique et ses services, avec une gouvernance formalisée des risques IA, mais adopte une approche prudente face aux défis réglementaires et opérationnels émergents.
